verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
              बृहतीं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सेनां दृष्ट्वा समुद्यताम् । विषादमगमद्राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Seeing the vast army of Dhritarashtra's son, the son of Kunti, king Yudhishthira, was filled with grief.
verses.bhavadeepa: अनन्तरूपा बह्वी त्वदीया न तु पाण्डवानां सेना बह्वी तथापि तां बृहतीमेव मन्ये इति सम्बन्धः॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: व्यूहं भीष्मेण चाभेद्यं कल्पितं प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवः । अभेद्यमिव सङ्प्रेक्ष्य विवर्णोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत् ॥२॥
verses.english: Having seen the impenetrable Vyuha formed by Bhishma and having concluded it to be really impenetrable, the king became pale and he thus spoke to Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: धनञ्जय कथं शक्यमस्माभिर्योद्धुमाहवे । धार्तराष्ट्रैर्महाबाहो येषां योद्धा पितामहः ॥३॥
verses.english: "O mighty armed hero, O Dhananjaya, how shall be able to fight with the Dhritarashtra's son's army when the grandfather himself commands it.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षोभ्योऽयमभेद्यश्च भीष्मेणामित्रकर्षिणा । कल्पितः शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना भूरिवर्चसा ॥४॥
verses.english: Immovable and impenetrable in this Vyuha, formed according to the rules of the Shastras, by that chastiser of foes, Bhishma of unfading glory.

verses.sanskrit: ते वयं संशयं प्राप्ताः ससैन्याः शत्रुकर्षण । कथमस्मान्महाव्यूहादुत्थानं नो भविष्यति ॥५॥
verses.english: O chastiser of foes, we are doubtful of success. How can victory be ours in the face of this (Kuru) army?

verses.sanskrit: अथार्जुनोऽब्रवीत्पार्थं युधिष्ठिरममित्रहा । विषण्णमिव सम्प्रेक्ष्य तव राजन्ननीकिनीम् ॥६॥
verses.english: O king, that chastiser of foes, Arjuna, thus spoke of your army to the son of Pritha, Yudhishthira, who was in great grief.
we O majesty! I tell you the manner by which handful warriors conquer the wiser and meritorious majority of warriors. Please, listen to it carefully.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ते कारणं राजन्प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे । नारदस्तमृषिर्वेद भीष्मद्रोणौ च पाण्डव ॥८॥
verses.english: O king, you are without malice. I shall therefore tell you of the means. The Rishi Narada as well as Bhishma and Drona know it.

verses.sanskrit: एनमेवार्थमाश्रित्य युद्धे देवासुरेऽब्रवीत् । पितामहः किल पुरा महेन्द्रादीन्दिवौकसः ॥९॥
verses.english: In the days of yore, at the battle between the celestial and the Danavas, the Grandfather himself said (the following) to Indra and the other celestial.

verses.sanskrit: न तथा बलवीर्याभ्यां जयन्ति विजिगीषवः । यथा सत्यानृशंस्याभ्यां धर्मेणैवोद्यमेन च ॥१०॥
verses.english: They that are desirous of victory do not so much conquer by might and prowess as by truth, compassion, piety and virtue

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा धर्ममधर्मं च लोभं चोत्तममास्थिताः । युद्ध्यध्वमतहङ्कारा यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः ॥११॥
verses.english: Therefore knowing the difference between piety and impiety and understanding what is meant by covetousness and having recourse to only be exertion, fight without any arrogance, for victory is certain to be there, where righteousness is.

verses.sanskrit: एवं राजन्विजानीहि ध्रुवोऽस्माकं रणे जयः । यथा तु नारदः प्राह यतः कृष्णस्ततो जयः ॥१२॥
verses.english: O king, for this reason, know that victory is certain to us in this battle. Narada said, "Victory is certainly there where Krishna is".

verses.sanskrit: गुणभूतो जयः कृष्णे पृष्ठतोऽभ्येति माधवम् । तद्यथा विजयश्चास्य सन्नतिश्चापरो गुणः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Victory is inherent to Krishna; it follows Madhava (Krishna); victory is one of his attributes, so is humility.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ततेजा गोविन्दः शत्रुपूगेषु निर्व्यथः । पुरुषः सनातनमयो यतः कृष्णस्ततो जयः ॥१४॥
verses.english: Govinda (Krishna) possess might which is infinite. Even in the midst of countless foes, he is without any beyond all pains. He is the most eternal Purusha. Victory is certainly there where Krishna is.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा ह्येष हरिर्भूत्वा विकुण्ठोऽकुण्ठसायकः । सुरासुरानवस्फूर्जन्नब्रवीत्के जयन्त्विति ॥१५॥
verses.english: In the days of yore, indestructible and invincible. Hari appeared and thus spoke loudly to the celestial and the Asuras, “who amongst you would be victorious?” The conquered (the celestial) said, “With Krishna in front we shall win victory”. It was through the grace of Hari that the celestial headed by Indra obtained (the sovereignty) of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: कथं कृष्ण जयेमेति यैरुक्तं तत्र तैर्जितम् । तत्प्रसादाद्धि त्रैलोक्यं प्राप्तं शक्रादिभिः सुरैः ॥१६॥
तस्य ते न व्यथां काञ्चिदिह पश्यामि भारत । यस्य ते यजमाशास्ते विश्वभुक् त्रिदिवेश्वरः ॥१७॥
verses.english: Therefore I do not find any cause for sorrow., You have the lord of the universe and the lord of the celestial to which victory to you.
